services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Whether planning a formal wedding, casual party, corporate outing or business meeting, the Daniel Island Club can provide the venue and attention to detail to ensure success. Our staff is dedicated to helping clients turn their vision into reality. First-class amenities, from an elegant ballroom and spacious boardroom to the Park Club's swim, tennis and fitness facilities, the Club offers numerous indoor and outdoor venues for member-sponsored events of all types and sizes. The Daniel Island Club is one of the premier wedding locations in Charleston, SC. Every wedding is considered a custom, one-of-a-kind affair. services.name: Tennis & Pickleball
services.desc: Both novice and seasoned players feel at home at the Tennis Pavilion, located just down the road from the main Clubhouse at the Park Club. It serves as home base for 14 courts and 6 pickleball courts. The Club's tennis professionals oversee a variety of instructional programs, events, classes and clinics for members of all ages and the membership sustain several active tennis leagues and teams. The Tennis Pavilion includes a full-service pro shop carrying the top names in tennis apparel and offering spectacular views of several courts. gap: Pricing for golf and other amenities
blurb: Daniel Island Club offers two championship 18-hole golf courses designed by Tom Fazio and Rees Jones, featuring Lowcountry marsh and creek views. Amenities include fitness, aquatics, tennis, pickleball, and club cottages for members and guests. Facilities include a main clubhouse for golf, dining, banquets, and a Park Club with pools, tennis, and outdoor dining.
